purpose: Post-execution extraction of fixed evidence. No original raw reads, model rerun, new warning thresholds, or counterfactual game simulation.

interpretation.funnel: Sequential descriptive gate counts; exclusion totals depend on gate order and are not causal attribution.
interpretation.support: Four conditional survivors gate the residual forecast, not the retrospective strict-opportunity flag; warm history is a distinct gate.
interpretation.censor: No-warning/right-censored/contaminated gaps are not true negatives or proof of no room for improvement.
interpretation.cohorts: Original continuous F boundaries. Gap assignment uses first warning or gap start; closure may fall outside its assigned cohort.
interpretation.clocks: All event examples remain in one peer Page performance clock; no cross-clock subtraction.
interpretation.online: Whole-report diagnostic eligibility is retrospective. Unflagged fields do not isolate a network cause.

clock.name: Page performance.now()
clock.timeOriginAvailability: The selected old RAF snapshots do not export timeOrigin; no cross-clock subtraction is performed.

boundary.rule: First native F crossings; full original order and terminal/tail remain in point rows.

peers.evidenceQualificationScope: Whole-report RAF validity and timeline structure/order errors are retrospective evidence gates, not reconstructed online signals. Future A gap durations do not feed forward warning calculations.

unmeasured.cause: Information-source-unidentified; unflagged observed fields do not isolate a network cause.
